allResults.rationale: Direct emissions from the combustion of diesel fuel in the company's own fleet fall under Scope 1 mobile combustion.
Refrigerant top-ups for plant HVAC systems result in direct fugitive emissions of HFC-32 owned or controlled by the reporting company, which falls under Scope 1.
Purchased electricity consumed in the reporting company's own facilities falls under Scope 2.
District heat supply purchased for office campus consumption represents indirect emissions from the generation of acquired electricity, steam, heating, and cooling.
Purchased raw materials such as aluminium sheets are part of a company's upstream value chain emissions.
Emissions from upstream air freight services operated by a third-party logistics provider (Nippon Air Cargo) fall under Scope 3, Category 4 (Upstream Transportation and Distribution).
Purchased electricity from the grid consumed by the reporting company falls under Scope 2 emissions.
Upstream transportation and distribution of goods purchased by the reporting company, operated by a third-party logistics provider (MSC Line), falls under Scope 3, Category 4.
Road freight of machine parts provided by a third-party logistics supplier falls under Scope 3, specifically upstream transportation and distribution.
Landfill disposal of waste generated in operations falls under Scope 3, specifically Category 5: Waste generated in operations.
Purchased aluminium sheets from a supplier fall under Scope 3, specifically embodied emissions from purchased goods and services.
Emissions from upstream and downstream transportation and distribution of goods in vehicles not owned or controlled by the reporting company fall under Scope 3.
Ocean freight provided by a third-party logistics supplier falls under upstream or downstream transportation and distribution.
Road freight of machine parts provided by a third-party logistics supplier falls under upstream transportation and distribution.
Purchased finished goods (cotton t-shirts) from a supplier fall under Scope 3, Category 1 (Purchased Goods and Services).
Disposal of waste generated in operations is classified under Scope 3, specifically as an upstream or downstream outsourced activity.
The purchase of a CNC machining centre classified as capital equipment falls under Scope 3, Category 2 (Capital Goods) of the GHG Protocol.

Well-to-tank upstream emissions associated with the production and transportation of fleet diesel fall under Scope 3, Category 3 (Fuel- and energy-related activities not included in Scope 1 or Scope 2).
Ocean freight provided by a third-party supplier (COSCO) for transporting goods falls under upstream or downstream transportation and distribution, which is categorized as Scope 3.

Landfill disposal of mixed production waste is an upstream or downstream activity occurring outside the reporting company's direct operations, specifically falling under waste generated in operations.
Business travel by employees on commercial airlines falls under Scope 3, Category 6 (Business Travel).
Employee commuting falls under Scope 3, Category 7 of the GHG Protocol.
